🦋 HOW TO RESIZE FOR YOUR BIBLE

Because every Bible is a little different in size, these butterflies can easily be resized before printing or cutting.

Import the transparent PNG into your cutting machine software or design program and resize the entire butterfly proportionally until it fits your Bible.

For the best fit:

1. Measure the height and width of your Bible page.
2. Decide how large you would like the butterfly to be when it is folded in half.
3. Resize the PNG while keeping the proportions locked so the butterfly does not become stretched or distorted.
4. Remember that the butterfly will be approximately half of its full open width once folded.
5. Do a test print on regular printer paper before printing on your final paper or cardstock.

Example: If you would like your folded butterfly to be approximately 3 inches wide, resize the open butterfly to approximately 6 inches wide before printing. You can make them smaller for Bible margins or larger when you want extra writing space.

HOW TO USE:

Print your butterfly onto your preferred paper, use your cutting machine to cut around the transparent design, write your notes in the blank center, and gently fold it vertically through the middle of the butterfly’s body.

You can tuck it between Bible pages, attach one side with removable adhesive or washi tape, or use it as a beautiful fold-out Bible journaling element.

HOW IT HELPS

Each morning you write who you are or are becoming, three things you are grateful for and one choice for the day; each evening, three good things, something you are proud of and tomorrow's affirmation. When an affirmation feels too big, the start page gives you bridge phrases like "I am learning to", and a worksheet helps you turn a heavy thought into a kinder, truer one. A monthly tracker, a weekly reflection and a monthly check-in show how the habit grows. This affirmation journal printable is undated, so a missed day never leaves a gap to catch up on.

• Page 1: Cover with a contents list and a This journal belongs to box

• Page 4: Affirmations 26 to 50, calm and peace, with tick boxes and space for favorites
• Page 5: Affirmations 51 to 75, confidence and courage, with tick boxes and space for favorites
• Page 6: Affirmations 76 to 100, gratitude and abundance, with tick boxes and space for favorites

• Page 8: Daily morning and evening page. Morning: I am, how I feel waking up, I am grateful for, today I choose, one kind thing I'll do for me and something to look forward to. Evening: three good things today, I am proud of, something I'm letting go of, a moment I want to remember and my affirmation for tomorrow
• Page 9: 30 gratitude prompts, such as a scent that makes you happy or a simple pleasure that costs nothing, plus space to answer one
• Page 10: My gratitude map with 8 areas to fill slowly: people, places, little things, your body, home, lessons, simple pleasures and opportunities
• Page 11: Monthly practice tracker with morning and evening ticks for 31 days and one good thing each day
• Page 12: Weekly gratitude reflection with this week's affirmation, the best moment of each day, someone you are grateful for and what to notice more next week
• Page 13: A thank-you letter to someone who made a difference, with what they did and how you'll share it
• Page 14: Monthly check-in rating gratitude practice, kind self-talk, rest, connection, joy and growth from 1 to 5, plus what you're releasing and welcoming

results.title: Affirmation Journal Printable, 52 Weekly Affirmations, One Page per Week, Self Love, Undated PDF
results.description:
Affirmation journal printable with one original affirmation for every week of the year, so each one has time to settle in. This undated affirmation journal printable has 63 pages: a writing guide, an index, 52 weekly pages, four quarterly reflections and a year-end reflection, in US Letter and A4 PDF. Instant download, nothing is shipped.

HOW IT HELPS

Each week you read one affirmation, note what it means to you, rate how true it feels at the start and the end of the week and write it once a day in your own words. A reflection prompt for every week, such as "Where can I let good enough be enough?", turns the words into real thinking. The 52 affirmations follow four themes, self-worth, calm and trust, growth and courage, and joy and gratitude, with a reflection page after every 13 weeks. This affirmation journal printable is slower and deeper than a daily journal, and you can begin any week of the year.

WHAT'S INSIDE (63 PAGES)

• Page 1: Cover with a contents list and a This journal belongs to box
• Page 2: How to use this journal, the six steps of each week, the four quarters, ways to keep your affirmation close and gentle rules
• Page 3: Affirmation writing guide with six simple principles, bridge statements, turning a worry into an affirmation, sentence starters and practice lines
• Pages 4 and 5: Index of all 52 affirmations with week, theme, page number and a done circle, plus your favorites
• Pages 6 to 18: Weeks 1 to 13, self-worth (Enough, Worthy, Voice, Body, Boundaries, Rest and more), each with the affirmation, what it means to you, how true it feels at the start and end of the week on a 1 to 5 scale, seven lines to write it in your own words with a said-it circle for each day, the week's reflection prompt and a moment it felt true
• Page 19: Quarter 1 reflection with the weeks you completed, the affirmation that helped most, how you talk to yourself now and what has shifted
• Pages 20 to 32: Weeks 14 to 26, calm and trust (Breathe, Present, Release, Ease, Patience, Quiet and more), each page laid out the same way
• Page 33: Quarter 2 reflection
• Pages 34 to 46: Weeks 27 to 39, growth and courage (Brave, Begin, Learn, Capable, Curious, Resilient and more)
• Page 47: Quarter 3 reflection
• Pages 48 to 60: Weeks 40 to 52, joy and gratitude (Joy, Grateful, Connection, Play, Beauty, Hope and more)
• Page 61: Quarter 4 reflection
• Page 62: My own affirmations for hard days, confidence, calm, relationships, goals and dreams, body and rest
• Page 63: Year-end reflection with your top five affirmations, how you talk to yourself now compared with a year ago, a letter to yourself and weeks completed out of 52

WHO THIS AFFIRMATION JOURNAL IS FOR

• Anyone who wants a gentle, unhurried affirmation practice instead of a new sentence every day
• People working on kinder self-talk, self-worth and a little more confidence
• Journalers who like one focused page a week and a short reflection prompt
• Anyone who wants a year-long self-care project they can start in any week

DESIGN AND PRINTING

• Elegant minimalist design: white pages with soft blush pink details that use very little ink
• Wide margins on every page, so nothing gets cut off on a home printer
• Two sizes: US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and A4 (210 x 297 mm), portrait
• Undated, so you can begin any week of the year and go at your own pace
• One affirmation and one full page for every week
• Works in a binder, on a clipboard or spiral bound at a print shop

• Read Me First, a short printing guide (PDF)

• Open the PDF in a free reader such as Adobe Acrobat Reader.
• Print at 100% or Actual size, portrait. Regular printer paper or 100 to 120 gsm paper works well.
• Print the guide and index once, then one quarter at a time, or print the whole year at a print shop and have it spiral bound.

GOOD TO KNOW

results.title: Decision Paralysis Ebook, The Decision Traffic Jam, How to Choose Between Too Many Options
results.description:
THE DECISION TRAFFIC JAM
A Practical Guide to Making Choices When Every Option Feels Too Complicated
A book by Grace Ellison
Priya stood in a store aisle with four browser tabs open, comparing blenders. Not luxury blenders, just a thirty-to-sixty-dollar replacement for the one that had died the week before. She read reviews for forty minutes and left without buying anything. She borrowed a neighbor's blender for two weeks, and when she finally chose one, it was because her sister told her which to get.
Nothing about that decision was complicated. A blender is not a house. But the effort it cost was far larger than what was at stake, and that gap, between how small a decision is and how large it feels while you are inside it, is what this book is about.
If you get stuck choosing, the problem is probably not laziness or a lack of information. Often it is the opposite: too much information, weighed too evenly, for too long. "Just pick one" treats the freeze as a willingness problem. For a lot of people it is not. It happens on its own when options look too alike, when a choice feels impossible to undo, or when something you already settled reopens for the third time this month.
The Decision Traffic Jam names three patterns behind a stalled decision (option overload, the fear of choosing wrong, and the decision that keeps reopening), gives each one a matched technique, and ties it all into a six-step process most everyday decisions can get through in about ten minutes. It is not a planner, an app or a decision tool, and it will not ask you to rebuild your life around a system.
WHAT YOU'LL FIND INSIDE
An introduction, nine chapters, a one-page quick reference and a closing note.
• Why "just pick one" fails: it aims at willpower, while the freeze comes from somewhere else, and a stalled decision is a matter of cost rather than poor judgment
• The three shapes of decision paralysis (option overload, wrong-choice fear and the reopening loop), and a short diagnostic that tells you which one is running
• How to narrow an overloaded field with a hard-requirements filter, a cap of three options in active comparison and a research time box, without missing what actually matters
• How to deal with the fear of choosing wrong: a reversibility check, a specific and realistic worst case, and the difference between a good decision and a good outcome
• How to close a decision that keeps reopening, with a written decision receipt that states the reasons and the conditions under which it is worth revisiting
• A good-enough filter and a three-tier stakes scale, so small choices stop costing more than they are worth and big ones still get real time
• A six-step process for most everyday decisions, with worked examples, built to be boring on purpose
• How to turn the pieces into a personal system, including what to do when you are short on time, deciding with a partner, or having a bad week
• The signs that the problem is bigger than decision paralysis, and when it is worth talking to a professional
• A single page to flip back to when a freeze is active
THIS BOOK MAY BE FOR YOU IF YOU:
• Spend forty minutes on a choice that should have taken five
• Compare near-identical options and never get closer to a pick
• Freeze with only two choices, because the fear is of being wrong afterward
• Make a decision, then quietly undo it and make it again without any new information
• Have been told to just pick one, flip a coin or trust your gut, and found that none of it helps
• Want a short, readable book that explains what is happening instead of handing you a list of tips
It is written for adults who get stuck choosing between alternatives, with or without an ADHD diagnosis.
WHAT THIS BOOK IS NOT
It is not about starting a task you have already decided to do, sorting a to-do list by urgency, group decision-making, negotiation or ethical judgment calls. It is not a diagnosis, a treatment for ADHD or any other condition, or a substitute for medical or professional care. It does not rely on a companion app, tracker or worksheet pack. The book, and its single quick-reference page, is the whole product.

results.title: Doris Miller Pearl Harbor Hero eBook, Black History WWII Sailor Story (PDF)
results.description:
He was only allowed to serve food. On December 7, 1941, he fought back.
 
Doris "Dorie" Miller was a 22-year-old Black sailor from Waco, Texas, working as a mess attendant aboard the battleship USS West Virginia when Japanese planes attacked Pearl Harbor. The Navy had never trained him to fire a weapon. That morning, he carried his mortally wounded captain to safety, took over an anti-aircraft machine gun under fire, and helped rescue injured shipmates from burning oil and water. He became the first Black American to receive the Navy Cross.
 
In 2020, the Navy announced that its future aircraft carrier CVN-81 would be named USS Doris Miller, the first carrier ever named for a Black American or an enlisted sailor. In August 2026, major news outlets reported that the Navy was discussing removing his name, with President Trump's name among those reportedly considered. This book tells the whole story, with the facts clearly sourced.
 
WHAT'S INSIDE
- The boy from Waco: Miller's early life in Jim Crow Texas
- A Navy divided: why Black sailors were kept away from the guns
- Minute-by-minute: what Miller did during the Pearl Harbor attack
- How the Black press and the "Double V" campaign made the nation learn his name
- The Navy Cross, presented by Admiral Nimitz, and the fight for the Medal of Honor
- His death at 24 aboard USS Liscome Bay
- His legacy: ships, statues, schools, films, and a postage stamp
- The aircraft carrier USS Doris Miller (CVN-81)
- The 2026 renaming controversy: what's confirmed, what's reported, and who said what
- Full timeline, key facts page, discussion questions, and source list
 
DETAILS

- Reads well on phone, tablet, computer, or e-reader, and prints cleanly
- Updated September 2026

Black History Month, Juneteenth, Veterans Day, Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day (Dec 7), homeschool and classroom lessons, book clubs, military history fans, and anyone who loves true stories of courage.

results.title: Course Workbook Template, 19 Pages x 5 Themes, Coaching Workbook (HTML to PDF)
results.description:
A workbook is the part of a course people actually keep. The videos get
watched once; the printed pages with their own handwriting on them stay on
the desk. This is that workbook — nineteen A4 pages in one HTML file that
you fill with your own course and print.

I built it the plain way on purpose: no Canva, no Figma, no subscription,
no design tool to learn. Open the file in any text editor, type over the
sample text, open it in a browser, print to PDF. The layout, the page
breaks and the A4 margins are already set, so what comes out is a clean
printable workbook you can attach to a lesson, send to a student, or take
to a print shop.

Five themes live in the same file — Classic (cream & dusty pink), Noir
(charcoal & gold), Editorial (white & cobalt), Sage (soft greens), Navy
(corporate). Switch with a button on the page; the switcher never prints.

What you get (instant download):
• One HTML file holding 19 A4 pages × 5 colour themes, plus a README

START — pages 1 to 5. Getting a student into the course.
• Cover, and a contents page with dotted leaders and real page numbers
• Welcome and how to use this workbook — the routine a student repeats
  before, during and after every lesson
• Before you start — why I am here, three goals, what success will look
  like — written down while motivation is still high
• Course roadmap — every module with a checkbox and a "done on" date

LEARN — pages 6 to 11. The part that repeats.
• Module spread — THE page you copy: module goal, key ideas, exercises,
  takeaway. Paste it once per module, change the numbers, and a six-module
  course is six spreads with one rhythm
• Questions and answers — five prompts with real room to answer, meant to
  be filled in from memory first and notes second
• Worksheet — short fields, a before/after table, a rating scale and one
  big open block for the exercise you assign
• Diagrams and visuals — empty frames to sketch in, paste a printout into,
  or annotate on screen
• Cheatsheet — 26 term-and-meaning entries in two columns, the page
  students print on its own and keep by the desk
• Glossary — your terms, defined by the student in their own words

PRACTISE — pages 12 to 16. Where a course turns into a habit.
• Checklist — before / during / after, a routine to reuse every lesson
• Practice tracker — five weeks by seven days of squares to tick
• Check yourself — six A/B/C questions with evidence lines and a tally, so
  a student places themselves honestly instead of guessing
• Progress and reflection — what clicked, what to revisit, a six-line
  self-check and a confidence scale to date and compare later
• Action plan — seven dated steps, smallest first, ending with the one
  thing to do tomorrow

FINISH — pages 17 to 19.
• Resources — books, links and tools, each with a "why it is here" line
• Notes — a lined sheet
• The last page — what you covered, what comes next, a line to sign and
  date

Also in the file:
• Editing notes on every block: what belongs in it and what to leave out
• One-line rebranding — change --accent at the top of the file and every
  accent across all nineteen pages follows
• A README covering editing, copying the module spread, renumbering pages
  and print settings

How to use it — three steps:
1. Open the HTML file in any text editor (VS Code, Sublime, Notepad,
   TextEdit). It is plain text, nothing to install.
2. Replace every [bracketed] placeholder with your own course content and
   delete the brackets. Search for "[" to find them all. Copy the module
   spread once per module you teach, then fix the page numbers on the
   contents page and in the footers — the README walks through it.
3. Open the file in your browser, pick a theme, then Cmd+P (Ctrl+P) →
   Save as PDF. Paper A4, margins "None", "Background graphics" enabled.

Honest about what this is not:
• It is a printed workbook, not an app — no fillable form fields, no
  auto-grading, no student logins, no progress tracking. Pages get filled
  in by hand, or with the annotation tool in a PDF reader.
• There is no certificate page in this file.
• The fonts come from Google Fonts, so it works best with internet on the
  first open.
• The content is yours. Every line inside is a bracketed placeholder —
  there is no ready-made curriculum written in here, and nothing pretends
  to be one.

Made for course creators, coaches, workshop and retreat hosts, tutors and
trainers — anyone who teaches in modules and wants students to leave with
pages, not just a video link.

Files in the download:
• course_workbook.html — 19 pages, 5 themes, one file
• README.txt — how to edit, how to add modules, how to print

Digital product — no physical item will be shipped.

FORMATS
- Fillable PDF: 55 pages, US Letter AND A4, color AND ink-saving black and white - plus 52 single-form PDFs on each paper size.

CONSENTS & POLICIES (8): General consent & release; Request for a doctor's note; Combined techniques consent; Photo & feedback release; Minor & guardian consent; Booking & package policy; Privacy & client-records notice; Pre-session health check
NEEDLES, CUPS & EAR (15): Acupuncture screening; Acupuncture consent; Acupuncture session record; Acupuncture before-care cards; Acupuncture aftercare cards; Cupping screening; Cupping consent; Cupping session record; Cupping before-care cards; Cupping aftercare cards; Electro & ear seeds screening; Electro & ear seeds consent; Electro & ear seeds session record; Electro & ear seeds before-care cards; Electro & ear seeds aftercare cards

results.title: GLP-1 Clinic Forms Bundle, Semaglutide Tirzepatide Consent, Intake, Dose Log, Aftercare, Editable Word PDF Med Spa Weight Loss Templates
results.description:
GLP-1 clinic forms written by an anesthesiologist.

This 5-document pack was drafted by an anesthesiologist, Carlos Fernández Ramos, MD, MBA (25+ years in anesthesiology & pain medicine; Expert Diploma in Obesity & Comorbidities, University of Navarra; Master's in Aesthetic Medicine; author of "Mi dieta con GLP-1"), and includes a dedicated section on anesthesia, sedation and procedure coordination. Injectable and oral forms are covered as the same treatment by a different route. The current U.S. labels of the named products (Wegovy® injection and tablets, Ozempic® injection, Rybelsus®/Ozempic® tablets, Zepbound®, Mounjaro® and Foundayo™) include a warning on pulmonary aspiration during general anesthesia or deep sedation.

References are listed by product, version and access date: current FDA Prescribing Information for Wegovy® (injection and tablets), Ozempic®, Rybelsus®/Ozempic® tablets, Zepbound®, Mounjaro® and Foundayo™ (orforglipron) (checked on DailyMed on 7 October 2026, including Wegovy HD 7.2 mg), FDA statements on compounded GLP-1s, and the 2024 multisociety perioperative guidance (ASA, AGA, ASMBS, ISPCOP, SAGES). The pack also includes clinician-adaptation fields and practice suggestions that are distinct from FDA labeling. Recheck the current label before use.

WHAT'S INCLUDED (5 editable Word .docx + 5 print-ready PDF, US Letter, plus a License & Notice PDF and a Sources PDF)
1. Patient Intake & Medical History (4 pp): BMI/vitals, prior GLP-1 use, a medical-history and safety screen covering label contraindications (MTC/MEN 2, serious hypersensitivity) and other matters requiring prescriber assessment (pancreatitis, gallbladder, retinopathy, gastroparesis, pregnancy/breastfeeding/planning, oral contraceptives, insulin/sulfonylureas, oral-tablet interactions, mental health, upcoming procedures and anesthesia history), medications, allergies, provider review & sign-off.
2. Informed Consent for GLP-1 Therapy (3 pp): benefits, alternatives, boxed warning with initials, important risks and precautions per FDA labeling, effects of stopping, injection or tablet product checklist, off-label section (Ozempic®, Rybelsus®, Mounjaro®), a section for compounded products (if applicable) summarizing FDA statements, a highlighted Anesthesia, Sedation & Procedures section, a telehealth checkbox and signature lines for the prescriber and any delegated health professional.
3. Dose Titration & Weight Tracking Log (3 pp, landscape): FDA-label escalation reference table (weekly injections and once-daily tablets, oral semaglutide and orforglipron, incl. missed-dose rules; the prescriber sets each dose), log with dose in mg, concentration and volume, lot #, injection site, weight, waist, BP, HR, side effects, initials; progress summary to week 52.
4. Side Effect Monitoring & Red-Flag Sheet (3 pp): "Call 911 / go to the ER now" vs. "contact the clinic promptly" warning signs, crisis-line guidance, hypoglycemia 15-15 rule, 8-week patient symptom checklist (no invented scores), clinic triage record, adverse-event log with FDA MedWatch fields.
5. Patient Aftercare & Pre-Procedure Instructions (2 pp): injection or tablet basics (how to take each tablet per its label), storage fields completed from the product leaflet, hydration, protein & strength training guided by the clinician (no generic targets), nausea/constipation tips, a "what to tell your surgery or sedation team" script and a cut-out wallet card.

WHY CLINICS CHOOSE IT
• A dedicated section on anesthesia, sedation and procedure coordination, written by an anesthesiologist
• References listed by product, label version and access date; label content distinguished from practice suggestions
• Clean, professional layout; your logo in the header; fully editable in Word
• Designed for med spas, weight-loss and wellness clinics, NPs, PAs and medical directors

HOW IT WORKS
Instant download → open in Microsoft Word (or Google Docs / Pages) → add your logo and clinic details → review with your medical director and counsel → print or upload to your EHR. PDFs are print-ready (they can be made fillable in Adobe Acrobat › Prepare Form).

IMPORTANT, PLEASE READ
These are templates for adaptation by licensed providers. They are not legal or medical advice and are not a substitute for the advice of an attorney licensed in your state or for the professional judgment of a licensed healthcare provider. Review with your medical director and local counsel before use; state laws on consent, scope of practice, supervision, telehealth and compounding vary. The author is licensed to practice medicine in Spain and is not licensed to practice medicine in the U.S.; purchase does not create a physician–patient, consulting or medical-director relationship, and we do not answer patient-specific clinical questions or review patient records. Record customer contacts, jewelry type, size or length, materials, engraving and special requests. Includes fields for pricing, deposit paid, balance due, payment method, delivery and order status.

2. JEWELRY REPAIR INTAKE FORM — 2 PAGES

Document the item received, its condition, requested repairs, estimate and client approval. The second page covers the work completed, final checks, charges, payment and collection or return.

3. JEWELRY CLIENT DETAILS FORM — 2 PAGES

Keep client contacts, ring sizes, measurement units and jewelry preferences together. Includes an order and repair history table, follow-up plan and space for notes.

PAPER SIZES

• A4: 210 × 297 mm  
• US Letter: 8.5 × 11 inches

Both sizes contain the same 5-page set. Choose the format that matches your paper.

One START HERE PDF with instructions and two Canva template links: one for the complete A4 bundle and one for the complete US Letter bundle.

Add your logo and business details, edit text, fonts and colors, then download your finished forms as a PDF. Print blank copies to complete by hand and reuse them for new clients, orders and repairs.

HOW IT WORKS

1. Purchase this digital bundle.
2. Once payment is confirmed, download the START HERE PDF from your Etsy account using a web browser.
3. Open the PDF and select OPEN A4 BUNDLE or OPEN US LETTER BUNDLE.
4. Sign in to Canva and open your own template copy.
5. Customize, download as a PDF and print at 100% scale on matching paper.

These are manual record forms. Amounts, balances and follow-up dates are entered by you; automatic calculations and reminders are not included.

DIGITAL PRODUCT

No physical item will be shipped. The templates are in English. Printing and editing services are not included. Colors may vary slightly between screens and printers.

You may use and print these forms for your own business. Resale, redistribution and sharing of the template links are not permitted.

Created by Mithiluna Studio with AI-assisted design tools and refined in Canva.

results.title: Photography Contract Template, Model Release Form, Wedding Photography Contract, Pricing Guide, Fillable PDF and Word, Paperwork Log
results.description:
PHOTOGRAPHY CLIENT & CONTRACT KIT
A photography contract template kit: a session agreement with four genre clause sets (wedding photography contract terms included), a model release form, property release and usage license, plus a session paperwork log (Excel and Google Sheets) that shows what each booking still needs signed and when its gallery is due. Every document, the pricing guide template included, comes in one download.

Twenty client documents, and every one comes three ways: a fillable PDF (click a blank and type), a print-and-pen PDF, and an editable Word (.docx) file. Nothing on them carries our branding. Put your own logo on and hand them over as your own. No monthly subscription: you buy it once and own the files.

These are general templates and guidance, not legal advice.

THE PROBLEM THIS SOLVES

A generic contract does not fit every kind of shoot. A wedding, a newborn session, a real estate shoot and a commercial video job each need different clauses, and a photographer who uses one form for all four can end up with a gap in the one that matters. The other half of the problem is keeping track: which booking still has an unsigned release, which gallery is due this week, and which old session folders are past the date you promised to keep them. This kit gives you the documents and the log that keeps tabs on them.

WHAT YOU GET

• 20 client documents, each as a fillable PDF, a print PDF and an editable Word file (66 pages in each PDF format)
• A 32-page Start Here guide: how to use the kit, the clauses that vary by state, the workflow from inquiry to archive, how to price a usage license, a filled-in usage license, and every document explained one by one
• A 6-page "Which Document Do I Need?" router that points 36 common situations, from the first inquiry to the archive email, at the right document
• The Session Paperwork & Release Log, a 9-tab workbook (.xlsx, plus a one-click link to your own native Google Sheets copy). It works in Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice. Room for 250 sessions and 2,000 Paperwork Log rows
• A read-me with the 30-second version of how to use any document

THE 20 DOCUMENTS

01 Photography & Video Session Agreement
02 Wedding & Event Clause Set
03 Newborn, Family & Portrait Clause Set
04 Real Estate & Architecture Clause Set
05 Commercial & Video Production Clause Set
06 Weather, Illness & Reschedule Addendum
07 Gallery Delivery & Archive Policy
08 Client Questionnaire
09 How to Prepare: Client Session Guide
10 Wedding & Event Timeline Worksheet
11 Shot List & Must-Haves
12 Second Shooter & Assistant Agreement
13 Model Release (Adult)
14 Model Release (Minor)
15 Property Release
16 Print Release
17 Usage License & Fee Schedule
18 Client Message Bank
19 Signed-Document Log
20 Pricing Guide & Package Menu

WHAT MAKES THIS DIFFERENT FROM A SINGLE FREE CONTRACT

• GENRE CLAUSE SETS. Four clause sets (wedding and event; newborn, family and portrait; real estate and architecture; commercial and video) attach to the Session Agreement, so the contract matches the kind of booking. The workbook marks which one each booking needs.

• THE RELEASES, ALL IN ONE PLACE. A model release form for adults, a separate one for minors, a property release, and a print release, plus a usage license and fee schedule for clients who want to use your images commercially.

results.title: Dog Behavior Guide Printable - 25 Habits Decoded, Body Language Chart, Dog Owner Gift
results.description:
Head tilts, zoomies, rolling in fox poo, growling over the food bowl — your dog is communicating all day long. This 28-page guide decodes 25 of the most common dog behaviours in plain English: what you're seeing, what it usually means, and what (if anything) to do about it.

Two page sizes included. Every purchase gives you both the A4 edition (210×297mm) and the US Letter edition (8.5×11in / 216×279mm), so it prints correctly wherever you are — no shrinking, no "fit to page". The US Letter edition also uses US spelling and measurements.

Each behaviour gets a full page with a consistent, skimmable layout: an at-a-glance summary, the most likely explanations in order of likelihood, and practical steps that use reward-based methods only — no gadgets, no punishment, no outdated "dominance" advice.

The guide opens with a short primer on reading your dog's whole body — tail, ears, mouth, eyes and weight — so you can judge any behaviour in context. It gives special attention to the quiet signals most owners miss (lip-licks, out-of-context yawns, "whale eye") that let you defuse situations long before a growl, and explains clearly why you should never punish a growl.

Where a behaviour can be health-related — scooting, tail-chasing, sudden clinginess, night-time restlessness — a clearly marked box tells you exactly when it's one for your vet, so nothing treatable gets dismissed as "just a quirk".

Printer-economical by design. There are no full-page colour backgrounds, no dark panels and no ink-hungry borders. Measured across all 28 pages, ink coverage averages 3.13% by ink density at 150 DPI and no page is less than 84% white or near-white — and it prints just as clearly in black and white. Reprinting a page uses barely any ink.

Please note: this guide offers general information about typical dog behaviour and is not a substitute for advice from your vet or a qualified, accredited behaviourist.

results.title: Carpeta Familiar De Emergencia | Spanish Emergency Binder Printable | Estate Organizer Espanol | Docomentos Importantes | 51 paginas
results.description:
Todo lo que su familia necesitaría saber — de los dos lados de la frontera — en un solo lugar. 51 páginas para imprimir en casa, en español, con los títulos en inglés para que sus hijos puedan ayudarle.
Hay una pregunta que empieza casi todos los pleitos entre hermanos:
"¿Dónde están las escrituras de la casa de mi mamá?"
Y casi siempre llega en el peor momento posible.
Esta carpeta contesta esa pregunta antes de que alguien tenga que hacerla. Y contesta otras cincuenta más.
No es un organizador en inglés traducido.
Los organizadores que se venden en inglés no tienen las páginas que una familia como la suya de verdad necesita. Esta carpeta sí:
— Las variaciones de mi nombre. Los dos apellidos se cortan, se juntan o se invierten en cada documento. El banco tiene un nombre, la licencia tiene otro, la escritura tiene otro. Cuando eso pasa, una cuenta se queda congelada por meses. Esta página lo resuelve.
— ¿Aquí o allá? La repatriación. Dónde quiere descansar, quién lo recibe allá, y un recordatorio de llamar al consulado antes de contratar cualquier servicio privado.
— Propiedad allá. La casa, el terreno, la parcela. Quién tiene las escrituras y en qué municipio están inscritas.
— Tandas, cundinas y préstamos de palabra. Dinero real que no aparece en ningún banco y que se pierde cuando nadie sabe explicarlo.
Diseñada con cuidado
Esta carpeta anota dónde están los documentos — nunca los números. Sin números de Seguro Social, sin números A, sin contraseñas. Si la carpeta se pierde, lo que contiene no puede usarse en su contra. Por eso se puede compartir con la familia sin miedo.
Letra grande, para llenarse a mano. Español arriba, inglés abajo. Márgenes listos para fólder de tres argollas. Se imprime igual de bien en blanco y negro.
Las diez secciones
Información personal
Documentos y dónde están
Contactos clave
Dinero y cuentas
Propiedad
Salud

✓ Hoja de instrucciones: cómo imprimirla y por dónde empezar
Un regalo difícil de dar, y de los más agradecidos
Muchas personas compran esta carpeta para sus papás. Si es su caso: no se la entregue y ya. Siéntese a llenarla con ellos. Se avanza el doble y se convierte en una de esas conversaciones que después nadie olvida.
Esta carpeta es un organizador. No es un testamento, no es un poder notarial y no es asesoría legal. Muchas familias descubren al llenarla cuáles documentos legales de verdad les hacen falta — y ésa es una de las cosas más útiles que hace.
Archivo digital. No se envía nada por correo. Para uso personal y familiar; no se permite revenderla.
